Bara: Step Challenges
HomeSupportPrivacy

Free on iPhone

Step challenges are more fun when you can steal steps from someone.

Bara turns your daily step count into a live race against your friends. Earn mystery boxes as you walk, unleash power-ups, steal steps, freeze your competition, and do whatever it takes to cross the finish line first.

What's in the boxes

Dozens of ways to shake up the race.

Mystery boxes drop as you walk. Some of what's inside speeds you up. The rest slows your friends down.

  • Runner's High

    2x your steps for an hour.

  • Wrong Turn

    Reverse a rival's steps for an hour.

  • Protein Shake

    +1,500 bonus steps, instantly.

  • Stealth Mode

    Hide your name, steps, and position for an hour.

  • Trail Mine

    Buries a trap at your step count. It goes off on the first rival to cross it.

  • Rainstorm

    Everyone else's steps count for half for an hour.
